Alex took over the roles of Carl and Lou, starting with the thirty-second season.
Richardson takes over the roles of Dr. Hibbert and Judge Snyder, starting with the thirty-second season. Prior to this, he voiced various minor characters.
DeLisle takes over the roles of Martin Prince, Sherri and Terri starting with the thirty-first season.
Lewis takes over the role of Bernice Hibbert, starting with the thirty-second season.

Brooks takes over the role of Lewis, starting with the thirty-second season.
Following Wallace's death in 2013, Edna Krabappel was retired from the show.
Following Hartman's death in 1998, McClure and Hutz were retired from the show. [ 46 ]
LaMarche has appeared in several minor roles since 1995. [ 49 ]
Made numerous guest appearances between 1991 and 2002. Dan Castellaneta now provides the voices after Welker left the show, having asked for a raise because the voices were hurting his throat. [ 50 ]
Lovitz has appeared in several episodes since 1991. [ 49 ]
Kaczmarek has appeared as Judge Harm since 2001. [ 49 ]
Brooks has appeared as one-time characters in several episodes since 1990. [ 51 ]
Close has appeared as Homer's mother Mona since 1995. The character was killed off in 2008, but has made several appearances in flashbacks since then.
Mason first appeared as Krusty's father, Rabbi Krustofski, in 1991. The character was killed off in 2014. Dan Castellaneta voiced the character in several episodes.
Hooks was the original voice of Manjula, and portrayed her between 1997 and 2002. Tress MacNeille currently voices Manjula.
Mullally has appeared as Sarah Wiggum since 2021 as part of a retool of her character. Pamela Hayden previously voiced her when she had a less prominent role in the series.
Hawking has made the most appearances of all the guest stars who have appeared as themselves on the show.
